That there was inadequate signage in this particular area of the Site where Shane entered the Lake warning him that Swimming was not permitted.
The area close to the Lake (where the accident occurred) is to be occupied by families with young children and there is no physical barrier to prevent young children entering the Lake..

The signage that is in place in other parts of the sites in a text format (with no 1 pictorial form) and therefore this signage does not provide for those individuals who cannot read or for children who are not of a reading age.
text-only signage inaccessible to illiterate or young children
